description:
Search EVE Online public contracts by what is inside them - blueprint ME/TE/runs, abyssal module rolls, and multi-item pack appraisal against Jita prices.


Added
- Copy an abyssal roll straight into pyfa. Each roll in the contract window
  has a pyfa button: open a fit in pyfa and paste, and the module or drone
  goes in with exactly this roll's stats, ready to try against your fit. Nothing
  is looked up online to do it. The button is left off a roll pyfa would rebuild
  wrong: one on a mutaplasmid or module newer than the app's data, and any Gas
  Cloud Harvester I or II, which pyfa itself mistakes for the older Gas Cloud
  Scoop.

Fixed
- A contract whose details can't be read says so. When its item lines or
  its rolled stats fail to load, the contract window explains it in their place
  instead of showing a contract emptier than the real one. Rolls that fail no
  longer take the readable item lines with them.
- The roll preview in the results list no longer says "No roll data" when it
  simply failed to read it, and hovering again now really does try again.
- Copying the in-game link reports a failure instead of doing nothing.
- A lone module's MutaMarket estimate looks like the link it is. The arrow
  icon is always shown and the figure underlines on hover, as each roll of a
  pack already did.

Neither the macOS nor the Windows build is code-signed - that needs a paid
certificate - so the first launch takes one extra step. macOS: open it,
Done, then System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Windows:
More info → Run anyway. Linux: chmod +x the AppImage (some distros
also need FUSE).
After that the app updates itself from this page: every build is minisign-signed
and the updater checks that signature before replacing anything. The .sig
files and latest.json are what makes that work - you don't need to download
them.
